methodology: Treat every pre-existing name and hierarchy as untrusted; confirm current 2026/27 club membership before evaluating penalty evidence.
Use official club squad, preseason call-up, signing, renewal, transfer, and contract sources for membership; reject rumours, departed players, and players without a confirmed current agreement.
Prioritize 2026 preseason and 2025/26 competitive in-match penalties, especially like-for-like events where rival takers were also available.
Use official match reports and statements first, then Fantacalcio/SOS Fanta set-piece analysis and credible Italian or local club reporting; career logs are fallback evidence only.
Exclude shootout attempts from regular-time hierarchy inference unless explicitly labelled; no shootout evidence determines a recommended position in this audit.
Confidence is assigned per position; every non-stable hierarchy remains provisional through the summer transfer window and must be rechecked after material squad or coaching changes.

status.note: Adams and Rrahmani have not yet been compared on the pitch for a Venezia penalty; Lauberbach's event occurred after Rrahmani went off and without Adams available.

clubs.rationale: Venezia officially signed Adams on 22 July. Goal ranks Adams ahead of Rrahmani, while SOS Fanta treats the two new forwards as the leading head-to-head; Adams's 3/3 at Sevilla gives him the narrow practical edge. The latest event adds a usable third: Lauberbach converted against Galatasaray on 27 July with Yeboah on the pitch, after Rrahmani had gone off and while Adams was not yet ready. The Adams-Rrahmani order is not settled by a like-for-like Venezia penalty. Lauberbach's event establishes him over Yeboah in that lineup but not over the absent Adams or substituted Rrahmani. Adorante is omitted from the three because he underwent back surgery on 25 July.
clubs.uncertainty_note: Adams and Rrahmani have not yet been compared on the pitch for a Venezia penalty; Lauberbach's event occurred after Rrahmani went off and without Adams available.
transfer_conditions: If preseason or competitive evidence shows Rrahmani taking with Adams on the pitch, move Rrahmani to primary. When Adorante returns from back surgery, reassess him against Lauberbach for tertiary. A departure by Yeboah does not alter the recommended three but reduces depth.
